description: This file is an internal header for Google Test framework, defining internal classes, macros, and functions used for testing infrastructure, assertions, and utilities.

classes.name: AssertionResult
classes.description: Represents the result of an assertion, indicating success or failure.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a failure message or output message in tests.

classes.name: TestInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a specific test.

classes.name: TestPartResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a part of a test, such as a failure or success.

classes.name: UnitTest
classes.description: Represents a collection of all test cases.

classes.name: TestFactoryBase
classes.description: Abstract factory interface for creating test instances.

classes.name: TestFactoryImpl
classes.description: Template implementation of TestFactoryBase for specific test classes.

classes.name: CodeLocation
classes.description: Stores file and line number where a test or assertion is defined.

classes.name: ConstCharPtr
classes.description: Helper struct to manage const char* with operator bool.

classes.name: Random
classes.description: Linear Congruential Generator for pseudo-random number generation.

classes.name: FloatingPoint
classes.description: Template class for precise floating-point comparison and representation.

classes.name: TypeIdHelper
classes.description: Helper class to generate unique type IDs.

classes.name: TypeId
classes.description: Type alias for a unique identifier for types.

classes.name: NativeArray
classes.description: Adapter class for native arrays to STL-like containers for testing.

methods.name: MakeAndRegisterTestInfo
methods.description: Creates and registers a new test info object with Google Test.

methods.name: GetTypeId
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for a given type.

methods.name: AppendUserMessage
methods.description: Appends user message to Google Test failure message.

methods.name: GetCurrentOsStackTraceExceptTop
methods.description: Returns current OS stack trace as string, skipping top frames.

methods.name: AlwaysTrue
methods.description: Returns true; used for warning suppression.

methods.name: AlwaysFalse
methods.description: Returns false; used for warning suppression.

methods.name: SplitString
methods.description: Splits a string into fields based on a delimiter.

methods.name: StreamableToString
methods.description: Converts a value to string for output.

methods.name: GetBoolAssertionFailureMessage
methods.description: Constructs failure message for boolean assertions.

methods.name: IsNullLiteralHelper
methods.description: Helper for compile-time null pointer literal detection.

methods.name: CreateUnifiedDiff
methods.description: Creates a unified diff string from two string vectors.

methods.name: CalculateOptimalEdits
methods.description: Computes optimal edit sequence between two sequences.

methods.name: DiffStrings
methods.description: Returns diff between two strings in unified format.

methods.name: AssertionResult
methods.description: Represents the result of an assertion, success or failure.

methods.name: TestPartResult
methods.description: Represents individual test part result.

methods.name: TestInfo
methods.description: Contains info about a test case.

methods.name: UnitTest
methods.description: Represents the entire test suite.

methods.name: TestFactoryImpl
methods.description: Template class to create test instances.

methods.name: GetTypeName
methods.description: Returns string name of a type.

methods.name: CodeLocation
methods.description: Stores file and line info for code location.

methods.name: SkipPrefix
methods.description: Skips a prefix in a string if present.

methods.name: GetPrefixUntilComma
methods.description: Extracts prefix until first comma.

methods.name: ArrayEq
methods.description: Compares two arrays for equality.

methods.name: ArrayAwareFind
methods.description: Finds element in range, considering array equality.

methods.name: CopyArray
methods.description: Copies array elements.
